newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-JP Morgan cuts Repsol.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-JP Morgan cuts Repsol.

text.p: Spanish energy group Repsol was cut to "market performer" at JP Morgan, the investment bank said on Monday.

Analysts at JP Morgan said they remained positive on Repsol's growth prospects but said the stock was near its existing price target of 6,500 pesetas and the strong fundamentals had been discounted by the share price.

They said the stock was trading at a 12 percent premium to the European integrated oil sector, despite regulatory risk in the domestic market and with an expected downturn in petrochemicals less than six months away.
However, they raised their 12-18 month share price target for Repsol to 6,750 pesetas.
